lines.gas_demand: {supplier}'s gas company presents the Zovar arrears, {arrears} million kron in hard currency, and asks when Ardenia means to pay.
lines.gas_threat: {supplier} mentions the valve again, and this time names a date: unless the arrears come down, deliveries fall next month.
lines.gas_threat_lapsed: The date named for the valve passes, and the gas keeps flowing.
lines.gas_cut: The valve is turned. Deliveries through the Zovar line fall by {share}%.
lines.gas_restored: Full deliveries resume on the Zovar line.
lines.gas_renewal: The Zovar contract is renewed at {price} a unit for three more years.
lines.gas_shortfall: Ardenia is short {share}% of the gas it needs this month.
lines.storage_ready: The gas storage programme is complete.
lines.second_line_open: The second supply line opens. For the first time Ardenia can heat itself without Krasova's leave.
